integrity: The universal formula is proved by an explicit feasible factorization and a positive two-point dual certificate. Computation is corroborative only. Full text of the two closest primary sources was inspected; residual originality risk remains for older work indexed under discrete interpolation or finite positivity terminology.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the discretized Carathéodory–Fejér problem with only the second harmonic free. It does not classify larger frequency sets, complex free coefficients, nonuniform sample sets, or extremizers in the divisible-by-eight case beyond one explicit extremizer.
title: Exact degree-two discretized Carathéodory–Fejér extremals on every cyclic grid
